dashboard.title: Bariatric support
dashboard.lastPhase: You are in the final phase

clearLiquid.name: Week 1: Clear liquids
clearLiquid.description: Clear liquids only: water, broth, sugar-free juice, tea. Small sips throughout the day.

fullLiquid.name: Week 2: Full liquids
fullLiquid.description: All liquids incl. protein shakes, soup, yogurt. Do NOT drink 30 min before/after meals.

pureed.name: Week 3-4: Pureed food
pureed.description: Blended/pureed food: cottage cheese, fish puree, blended chicken. Chew thoroughly.

soft.name: Week 5-6: Soft food
soft.description: Soft food: scrambled eggs, fish, cooked vegetables, soft fruit. Protein first, small bites.

regular.name: Week 7+: Regular food
regular.description: Regular food in small portions. Protein first, then vegetables, then carbs. Chew thoroughly.

tips.noDrinking: Do NOT drink 30 min before or after meals
tips.stopWhenFull: Stop when full - even with small portions

fluid.title: Fluid intake today
fluid.subtitle: Drink between meals, not with
fluid.warning: Remember small sips - not large amounts at once

reminders.title: Remember at meals
reminders.newFoodOneAtATime: Introduce one new food at a time

dumping.title: Dumping syndrome risk
dumping.subtitle: Based on today's meals
dumping.mediumDesc: One or more meals may trigger dumping. Watch for symptoms.
dumping.highDesc: Multiple high-risk meals today. Contact your doctor if you experience nausea, rapid heartbeat, dizziness or diarrhea.
dumping.info: Dumping is most common after gastric bypass and triggered by sugar, fat or fast-absorbed carbs. Symptoms: nausea, rapid heartbeat, dizziness, diarrhea 15-30 min after meals.

training.title: Adapted training
training.subtitle: Recommended activity for your phase

phaseDesc.1: Stick to short walks and deep breathing exercises. Listen to your body and rest plenty.
phaseDesc.2: You can increase walking a bit. Still no strength training or intense exercise.
phaseDesc.3: You can start cycling and swimming (once wounds are healed). Still no running or heavy weights.
phaseDesc.4: Time to introduce light strength training and longer cardio. Start with small weights.
phaseDesc.5: You can return to normal training - but still build gradually and watch your energy.

warnings.title: Important to remember
warnings.avoidSwimmingUntilHealed: Avoid swimming until your wounds are healed (typically 3-4 weeks)
warnings.lightWeightsOk: Light weights (2-5 kg) are OK after consulting your doctor
warnings.startStrengthGradually: Start strength training with low weights and high reps
warnings.stillBuildGradually: Still build gradually - avoid sudden large increases
warnings.hydration: Remember fluids before, during and after training

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: At RunWithAI, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information.

sections.title: Data controller
paragraphs: RunWithAI is responsible for processing your personal data. Contact us at privacy@runwithai.app if you have questions.

sections.title: Data we collect
paragraphs: We collect the following types of data:
bullets: Account information: email, name, age, and gender
Workout data: activities, distance, pace, heart rate, and GPS routes
App usage: preferences, goals, and level
Payment information: handled securely by the App Store or Google Play

sections.title: Third-party integrations
paragraphs: RunWithAI may integrate with Garmin Connect to import running data. When connected, we retrieve workout data only — never your login credentials.

sections.title: Data sharing
paragraphs: We never sell your data. We only share data with:
bullets: Hosting providers: Vercel and Railway for data storage

sections.title: Your rights
bullets: Delete your account and all data

sections.title: Data retention
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, all data is removed within 30 days.

sections.title: Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: We use minimal cookies to keep you signed in. We do not use third-party tracking or advertising cookies.

sections.title: Children's privacy
paragraphs: RunWithAI is not intended for children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect data from children under this age.

sections.title: Policy changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy from time to time. We will notify you in the app or by email about material changes.
